coverage.description: pow first consumes postfix; if ^ follows it advances once and parses unary as exponent, producing Pow(base,exponent). postfix repeatedly adds Fact or Index nodes after a primary. Unary may recursively reenter pow, so exponentiation associates right while leading minus wraps the power.
